They've also spotted an undrilled extension of the high-grade tin trend nearby. Critical Mineral Resources PLC (LSE:CMRS, FRA:98J) is targeting October for its maiden resource estimate at the Agadir Melloul copper project in Morocco. Independent consultants say they're impressed by what they've seen so far. Bradda Head Lithium Ltd (AIM:BHL) has started drilling at its Whistlejacket lithium project in Arizona. Historic holes there all intersected lithium, some at pretty high grades. Mila Resources PLC (LSE:MILA) has identified some compelling copper and gold targets at its Monal project in Queensland. news.title: Australia passes law to levy tech giants that fail to pay for local news
news.summary: Australia passed legislation on Thursday that will force tech giants to pay millions of dollars in ‌levies if they fail to strike commercial deals with local ‌media outlets for news on their platforms.  Proceeds from the scheme would be directed to local Australian news outlets, whose content helps drive user engagement and advertising revenue on the tech firms' platforms.  The levy applies to Meta, Alphabet's Google, ‌TikTok and Microsoft's LinkedIn, ⁠covering companies with a "significant" social media or search service in Australia, and local advertising revenue exceeding A$250 million ($178 million).
